chat_history.content: Who are the judges in the supreme court right now and where did each judge get their undergraduate degree?

content.content:
The user asks: "Who are the judges in the supreme court right now and where did each judge get their undergraduate degree?" Likely refers to US Supreme Court. Need current justices (as of today 2025-10-30). Provide list of current Supreme Court Justices and their undergraduate institutions.

We need up-to-date info. As of 2025, the composition might be same as 2024: Chief Justice John Roberts, Associate Justices: Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, Amy Coney Barrett, and possibly a new appointment if any retirements. Let's check. As of 2023, there were 9 justices: Roberts, Thomas, Alito, Sotomayor, Kagan, Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, Barrett, and Ketanji Brown Jackson (who was appointed 2022). Wait I missed Ketanji Brown Jackson. Yes the current justices are: John Roberts (Chief), Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, Sonia Sotomayor, Elena Kagan, Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, Amy Coney Barrett, Ketanji Brown Jackson.

Thus list all 9 and their undergraduate schools: Roberts - Harvard College (Harvard University). Thomas - College of the Holy Cross. Alito - Princeton University (Bachelor of Arts). Sotomayor - Princeton University. Kagan - Princeton University (Bachelor of Arts). Gorsuch - Columbia University (BA). Kavanaugh - Yale University (BA). Barrett - Rhodes College (formerly Southwestern at Memphis). Jackson - Harvard College.

Check: Amy Coney Barrett earned BA from Rhodes College in Memphis, Tennessee. Ketanji Brown Jackson earned BA from Harvard College.

Thus answer.

We should double-check any recent changes: As of 2024, Justice Barrett is still on Court. No retirements. So answer accordingly.

Thus no need for external lookup. Provide concise list.

content:
**Current U.S. Supreme Court Justices (as of 30 Oct 2025) and the colleges where they earned their undergraduate degrees**

| Justice (role) | Undergraduate institution | Degree / Year* |
|----------------|--------------------------|----------------|
| **John G. Roberts Jr.** – Chief Justice | **Harvard College** (Harvard University) | B.A., 1979 |
| **Clarence Thomas** – Associate Justice | **College of the Holy Cross** (Worcester, MA) | B.A., 1971 |
| **Samuel A. Alito Jr.** – Associate Justice | **Princeton University** | A.B., 1975 |
| **Sonia Sotomayor** – Associate Justice | **Princeton University** | B.A., 1976 |
| **Elena Kagan** – Associate Justice | **Princeton University** | A.B., 1986 |
| **Neil M. Gorsuch** – Associate Justice | **Columbia University** | B.A., 1988 |
| **Brett M. Kavanaugh** – Associate Justice | **Yale University** | B.A., 1988 |
| **Amy Coney Barrett** – Associate Justice | **Rhodes College** (Memphis, TN) | B.A., 1994 |
| **Ketanji Brown Jackson** – Associate Justice | **Harvard College** (Harvard University) | B.A., 1992 |

\* The listed degree is the standard undergraduate credential (B.A. = Bachelor of Arts; B.S. = Bachelor of Science) and the year of graduation.

These are the nine current members of the United States Supreme Court and the colleges where each earned their undergraduate education.
